biggest_catch: Requires parking $25,000 of new money for 90 days in a business High Yield Relationship Savings account. Branch opening with code 2026EM; offer expires 2026-10-31; OR/WA/CA/ID only.
catches: Open a new Banner Bank business High Yield Relationship Savings account at a Banner Bank branch and use promotional code 2026EM at account opening.
Deposit a minimum of $25,000 of new money (not held at Banner Bank) into the account within 60 days.
Maintain a minimum balance of $25,000 for 90 days.
Must not already have a Banner Bank business savings or money market account; not available to government entities, nonprofits, PACs, or campaign accounts.
Not available to businesses whose Banner accounts were closed within the last 2 years, or closed within 90 days / closed with a negative balance in the last 3 years.
One new-account-opening bonus every 2 years per business entity with a unique tax ID on business savings or money market.
Offer available to residents of OR, WA, CA, and ID only.
Bonus deposited into the new account within 30 days after requirements are met; account must be open and in good standing at payout.
Offer expires 10/31/2026; subject to change without notice; may not be combined with any other offer.
Bonus is considered interest and reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.

c3.evidence: Amount, $25,000 new-money requirement, 60-day funding window, 90-day maintenance, branch/code requirements, geography, and 10/31/2026 expiry are quoted verbatim from the official page.
